description: History for one coin. series: price (default: near-live hourly or daily bars, oldest first), funding_oi (the intraday open interest and funding path), daily (the recorded daily archive of funding, open interest, price and liquidations for the coin), whale_daily (the recorded daily whale buy and sell flow for the coin).

coin.description: Coin symbol, e.g. BTC. A pair like ETH/USD works too.

cursor.description: Next page: the cursor from the previous answer.

days.description: How many days back to read.

detail.description: brief (default): the answer, key numbers and top rows. full: every row, paged with cursor.

hours.description: How many hours back to read.

limit.description: Rows to return (usually up to 720; more is clamped and said).

name: history

access_note.description: What this connection could not return.

available.description: False: no data; note says why.

title: Price and funding history
